sources.label: Patches for Android TV apks
sources.author: ajstrick81
patch_list: Removes Xumo Play's client-inserted (CSAI) VOD ads by no-opping the player's ad-play step (playAmsOrImaAd) so fetched VAST/AMS/IMA ads are never played and content continues. Applies to both the VOD and Live TV players. FreeWheel SSAI ads…
